candidate_pool: P6-G3 valid nonidentity unique G1 RAW offspring only; no parents and no E0/E1/H1 pools

decision_rules.hardness_preserved_PARTIAL: one of those two conditions holds
decision_rules.hardness_preserved_YES: B mean predicted CE >= A in >=2 seeds and B/A grand mean >=0.98
decision_rules.stable_gain_NOT_SUPPORTED: B Original70 mean gap >= A in all 3 seeds
decision_rules.stable_gain_SUPPORTED: B Original70 mean gap < A in all 3 seeds
decision_rules.structure_retained_PARTIAL: B > A in >=2 seeds or median advantage >0
decision_rules.structure_retained_YES: B FFT coverage > A in all 3 seeds and median advantage >=3 references

selection: one max M4-HGB40 per occupied frozen QD4/CVT-1000 niche, then global HGB40 fill
